answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so stale endorsements fade and identities must provide sustained honest service to gain influence. EigenTrust-style scores use normalized, reciprocity-weighted trust paths; freshly spawned sybil identities have almost no trusted incoming mass, giving them near-zero eigenvector centrality and preventing them from passing consensus thresholds. A delta in local scores, even a whisper of collusion, cannot make onyx credible without durable corroboration.
